title: Evidence Timeline and Ping Product Map
lede: Read the complete story from discovery and identity through delegation, policy, approval, protocol execution, and governance evidence.

steps.title: 1. Where is the agent?
steps.what: Discovery evidence names the channel, runtime, and initial classification. (discover)

steps.title: 2. Who owns it?
steps.what: Registration evidence relates identity, owner, and lifecycle state. (register)

steps.title: 3. Is it genuine?
steps.what: Authentication and delegation preserve person and agent identities. (authenticate)

steps.title: 4. What can it do?
steps.what: Policy, consent, scope, audience, and Privilege set action boundaries. (authorize)

steps.title: 5. What did it do?
steps.what: Protocol, tool, lifecycle, and audit events complete the accountable story. (govern)
